content:
Leila: Quick heads-up onboarding emberlite-embed on news-qa holdout. FP16 baseline good but int8 single run shows recall@5 drop.

Leila: FP16 recall@5=0.812, int8 recall@5=0.784. Precision and nDCG also down slightly.

Omar: Were batching/padding/packing settings changed for the int8 runner?

Leila: Yes, int8 run used dynamic padding + token-packing to save memory; fp16 was fixed-pad 512.

Priya: That can alter microbatch composition and kernel selection, amplifying small numeric diffs into neighborhood changes. Also check quant calib mode (per-channel vs per-tensor).

Sam: Per-channel often preserves embeddings better. Any chance the int8 run used per-tensor quick-calib?

Leila: It did. I re-ran with fixed-pad=512 and disabled packing, still per-tensor: recall@5=0.799 (improved).

eval-bot: Job 4444444455 queued: eval_embed(emberlite-embed,int8,calib=per_channel,pack=off,pad=512)

Leila: Re-run with per-channel + fixed-pad + packing disabled: recall@5=0.808, ndcg almost same as fp16. Per-anchor TSV shows ~3.4% anchors moved >5 ranks in top-100.

Omar: That looks borderline. For onboarding gates we should define thresholds: propose accept if recall@5 drop <=0.25% and anchors moving >5 positions <=3%. Otherwise mark quant profile as opt-in with notes.

Priya: I agree being stricter for customer SLAs. Also add deterministic eval checklist: fixed-pad, packing off, set RNG seed, run 3 seeds (42, 271828, 314159) to estimate seed sensitivity.

Sam: Capture per-example TSV: id, rank_fp16, rank_int8, delta. We'll use that in the regression test generator.

Leila: Running 3-seed sweep now (fp16 and int8 per-channel). Will upload artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/emberlite/v1/seed-sweep/ (umap, ranks.tsv, manifests) and open a PR with recommended gate.

Priya: Also add a small script that computes percent anchors with |delta|>k for k in [1,5,10]; failing CI if median delta >2.

Leila: Will include that. TL;DR: dynamic padding/packing + per-tensor quant amplified drift. Fix: use fixed-pad + per-channel + seed-sweep to validate int8 before onboarding.

Sam: Nice triage. Thanks for the artifacts and PR.
